ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.definition: The work of managing your own feelings and other people's feelings so that the situation keeps running.
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.gloss: The work of managing your own feelings and other people's feelings so that the situation keeps running.
自分や他人の感情を調整し、状況Citationを続けるための労力。

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.definition: 자신의 감정을 조절하고 타인의 감정 반응을 관리하여 상황의 흐름을 유지하는 일을 말한다. 겉으로만 감정을 바꾸어 보이는 것도 포함할 수 있다.
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.gloss: 상황을 유지하기 위해 자신과 타인의 감정을 관리하는 노동.

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.definition: O trabalho contínuo de controlar ou expressar emoções para favorecer o bem-estar e o funcionamento das relações e das atividades.
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.gloss: Gerenciar as próprias emoções e as dos outros para manter uma situação em andamento.

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.definition: Kerja emosional mencakup upaya mengendalikan emosi serta membantu mengelola emosi orang lain demi kelancaran situasi. Usaha ini sering tidak terlihat meskipun-Upaya cukup besar.
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.gloss: Usaha mengelola perasaan sendiri dan perasaan orang lain agar situasi tetap berjalan.

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.definition: งานที่มองไม่เห็นในการควบคุมอารมณ์ของตนเองและตอบสนองต่อความรู้สึกของผู้อื่นเพื่อให้สถานการณ์ดำเนินไปได้ งานนี้มักไม่ได้รับการมองเห็นหรือได้รับการตอบแทน
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.gloss: งานที่ต้องจัดการอารมณ์ของตนเองและความรู้สึกของผู้อื่น

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.definition: Bir durumu sürdürmek için kendi duygularını ve başkalarının duygularını yönetme çabası. Çoğu zaman görünmezdir ve kişinin üstlendiği bir rolün gereğidir.
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.gloss: Kendi ve başkalarının duygularını yöneterek durumun sürmesini sağlamak için harcanan çaba.

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.translation: Toplantıyı sakin tutmak için harcadığı duygusal emek kimse tarafından fark edilmedi.
ภาระทางอารมณ์คืองานที่มองไม่เห็นในการทำให้บรรยากาศการประชุมสงบ
Kerja emosional merupakan pekerjaan tak terlihat untuk menjaga suasana rapat tetap tenang.
O trabalho emocional de manter a equipe calma consumiu mais energia do que ela mesma percebeu.
회의를 차분히 유지하려고 자신의 감정을 다스리는 것은 감정 노동이다.
会議を穏やかに保つための目に見えない仕事が、感情労働である。

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.text: Emotional labour is the invisible work of keeping a meeting calm.

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.definition: The work of managing your own feelings and other people's feelings so that the situation keeps running.
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.gloss: The work of managing your own feelings and other people's feelings so that the situation keeps running.

ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.text: Emotional labour is the tone you set and the mood you repair, and it rarely appears on a rota.
ef4d95705e01c9b04abbf037719c4fa19122ab01.translation: Công việc cảm xúc là giọng điệu bạn tạo dựng và tâm trạng bạn khôi phục, và nó hiếm khi xuất hiện trên lịch trực.

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.definition: Means held back from the first effort and kept for the moment the situation turns.
ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.gloss: Means held back from the first effort and kept for the moment the situation turns.

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.definition: 最初の攻撃や major operations には投入せず、情勢が転じたときに使用できるよう確保する予備兵力・予備物資など。単数形でも「予備」を指す。
ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.gloss: 初動に投入せず、情勢が変化した時点で使うために保管する兵力・物資。

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.definition: 처음의 노력에서 따로 남겨 두고 상황이 바뀌는 순간까지 보관해 두는 수단을 이른다. 병력이나 물자, 자금 따위를 미리 비축해 두는 것을 뜻한다.
ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.gloss: 처음의 전력에서 남겨 두었다가 상황이 바뀌는 때에 쓸 수 있는 수단.

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.definition: Em operações militares, reservas são meios de que se abstém no primeiro esforço e se conserva para usar quando a situação mudar. O termo pode indicar tropas, equipamentos ou outros recursos disponíveis para uma fase posterior.
ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.gloss: Recursos ou forças mantidos em reserva para uma necessidade posterior.

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.definition: Bahan, pasukan, atau kemampuan yang ditahan dari penggunaan pertama dan disimpan sebagai cadangan. Cadangan ini dapat digunakan ketika keadaan berubah atau kebutuhan baru muncul.
ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.gloss: Sumber daya yang sengaja disimpan untuk digunakan ketika situasi berubah.

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.definition: กำลัง ทรัพยากร หรืออุปกรณ์ที่ถูกเก็บไว้จากการดำเนินงานระยะแรก เพื่อนำมาใช้เมื่อสถานการณ์เปลี่ยนแปลง
ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.gloss: กำลังและทรัพยากรที่เก็บไว้ใช้เมื่อสถานการณ์เปลี่ยน

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.definition: Yedekler, ilk harekette kullanılmayarak koşullar değiştiğinde devreye sokulmak üzere saklanan birlik, araç, cephane veya erzakları ifade eder.
ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.gloss: İlk çabaya harcanmak üzere tutulan ve durum değiştiğinde kullanılacak güç ve kaynaklar.

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.translation: Plan, ikinci hafta için bir yedek birlik ayırmıştı.
แผนเก็บกำลังสำรองหนึ่งหน่วยไว้ใช้ในสัปดาห์ที่สอง
Rencana itu menyisakan satu cadangan untuk minggu kedua.
O plano guardou uma reserva para a segunda semana.
계획은 한 주를 위해 예비 자원을 따로 남겨 두었다.
計画では、二週目に備えて予備兵力を一隊残していた。

ef600ec32ebaf6468a74db166278d019536eee01.text: The plan kept one reserve for the second week.

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.definition: The price above which the deal is worse than your best alternative.
ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.gloss: The price above which the deal is worse than your best alternative.

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.definition: この金額を超えると取引条件が最良の代替案より悪くなり、交渉を打ち切ると判断する価格。事前に決めておくことで、交渉中の焦りが直接影响 ambiguities。
ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.gloss: 取引を断念する上限価格。

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.definition: 포기 가격이란 그 이상의 조건에서는 최선의 대안보다 거래가 불리해져 협상을 끝내고 떠나게 되는 가격이다. 처음부터 명확히 정해 놓고 협상 중에는 쉽게 바꾸지 않는 것이 중요하다.
ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.gloss: 이 가격보다 불리하면 거래를 포기하게 되는 기준.

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.definition: Valor acima do qual a proposta é pior do que a melhor alternativa disponível. É um limite que pode ser definido antes da negociação para evitar aceitar um negócio desfavorável.
ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.gloss: O preço máximo aceitável em uma negociação ou compra.

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.definition: Harga batas adalah titik ketika menawarkan tidak lagi menguntungkan dibandingkan pilihan lain yang tersedia. Setelah ditetapkan, harga ini biasanya menjadi acuan agarLamaran tidak terus meningkat selama negosiasi.
ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.gloss: Harga tertinggi yang masih membuat suatu kesepakatan lebih baik daripada alternatif terbaik.

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.definition: ราคาที่กำหนดไว้ล่วงหน้าเพื่อใช้เป็นเกณฑ์ระหว่างการเจรจากับผู้ขาย เมื่อราคาเกินกำหนดนี้ควรพิจารณาทางเลือกอื่นหรือถอนตัว
ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.gloss: ราคาสูงสุดที่ยอมจ่ายได้โดยยังดีกว่าทางเลือกอื่น

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.definition: Pazarlıkta, teklif bu fiyatı aştığında işlemi sonlandırmaya karar verilen en yüksek fiyattır. En iyi seçeneği belirlemeye ve pazarlıkta sınır koymaya yardımcı olur.
ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.gloss: Bu fiyatın üzerinde işlemi kabul etmeyi reddetme sınırı.

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.translation: Vazgeçme fiyatını bir hafta önce belirlemiş ve görüşme sırasında değiştirmemişti.
เขากำหนดราคาสูงสุดที่จะยอมจ่ายไว้หนึ่งสัปดาห์ก่อน และไม่เปลี่ยนแม้ขณะเจรจา
Dia menetapkan harga batasnya seminggu sebelumnya dan tidak mengubahnya selama negosiasi.
Ele definiu seu preço-limite uma semana antes e não o alterou durante a negociação.
그는 일주일 전에 포기 가격을 정했고, 협상 중에도 그 가격을 바꾸지 않았다.
彼は1週間前に撤退価格を決め、交渉中にそれを変更しなかった。

ef6f9efb4e5772a8fd895741721254ae18d2885c.text: He set his walk-away price the week before, and he did not move it in the room.

ef7c967436632d3042bdfbdb366f33b500a67223.definition: Hàm lượng giác của một góc, ký hiệu sin.
The trigonometric ratio sin of an angle.
ef7c967436632d3042bdfbdb366f33b500a67223.gloss: The trigonometric function of an angle, written sin.

ef7c967436632d3042bdfbdb366f33b500a67223.translation: Hàm sin và hàm cos đều tuần hoàn.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.definition: To respond to an offer with a different figure, as in a negotiation.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.gloss: To respond to an offer with a different figure, as in a negotiation.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.definition: 交渉で相手の提示を受け入れる代わりに、別の金額や条件を提示すること。
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.gloss: 交渉で相手の提示に別の金額を返す反提案。

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.definition: 상대가 제시한 제안에 대해 다른 금액이나 조건으로 응하는 행위이다. 처음부터 자신의 제안을 제시하는 것과는 구별된다.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.gloss: 협상에서 상대 제안과 다른 금액이나 조건을 제시하는 대응.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.definition: Nova proposta apresentada em resposta a uma oferta, com outro valor ou outra condição. Em uma negociação, contrapropostas podem se alternar até chegar a um acordo.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.gloss: Resposta a uma oferta com um valor diferente, como numa negociação.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.definition: Tawaran yang dibuat sebagai balasan atas tawaran lain dengan jumlah atau ketentuan yang berbeda. Istilah ini menunjuk tawarannya, bukan tindakan membalas.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.gloss: Tawaran balasan dengan angka berbeda dalam negosiasi.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.definition: การตอบข้อเสนอด้วยตัวเลขอื่นในการเจรจา เช่น การเสนอราคาที่สูงหรือต่ำกว่าข้อเสนอเดิม
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.gloss: ข้อเสนอราคาแย้งในการเจรจา

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.definition: Bir pazarlıkta yapılan teklifi kabul etmek yerine farklı bir tutar belirterek verilen karşı tekliftir.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.gloss: Pazarlıkta bir teklif, farklı bir rakamla yanıtlanarak karşı teklif verilir.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.text: They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.translation: Bin altı yüz elli dolar teklif ettiler, ben de bin sekiz yüz dolarlık karşı teklif verdim.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.text: They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.translation: พวกเขาเสนอ 1,650 ดอลลาร์ ฉันจึงเสนอแย้งที่ 1,800 ดอลลาร์

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.text: They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.translation: Tawaran balasan mereka adalah $1.800, lebih tinggi daripada tawaran awal sebesar $1.650.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.text: They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.translation: Ofereceram 1.650 dólares, então fiz uma contraproposta de 1.800.

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.text: They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.
They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.
efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.translation: 相手が1,650ドルを提示したので、私は1,800ドルで反提案しました。

efe899c74558f20b08bbc19bf0228c0c25bddb78.text: They offered $1,650, so I countered with $1,800.
